blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) on instruction data can quietly erode their safety, even when no training example looks harmful. Because this safety-degrading data looks benign, standard content filters struggle to catch it. We tackle this problem by developing SimpleLoRIF, a scalable gradient embedding method that identifies fine-tuning examples whose gradients align with unsafe behavior. By simplifying a low-rank attribution method and restricting backpropagation to the final four transformer blocks, SimpleLoRIF can embed datasets on the order of a million examples, boosting gradient attribution from a small-scale analysis tool into a practical filter for full post-training datasets. We first validate it on emergent misalignment, where we find that gradients can connect insecure-code training data to the broadly harmful behaviors that appear after fine-tuning, with AUC as high as 0.865 in the gradient space of misaligned models. We then use SimpleLoRIF to build SafeTulu, a version of Tulu 3 with the 20% of examples most gradient-aligned with unsafe responses removed. Training on SafeTulu reduces GCG attack success rate by up to 22% across Qwen, Llama, and Olmo, outperforming both LLM-as-a-judge and prior gradient-based filtering, while largely preserving or even improving capability. Finally, we analyzed the removed data and identify possibly under-studied sources of safety degradation, such as tool-execution failures and narrative arithmetic. We release SafeTulu along with a Hugging Face Space that lets researchers build their own customized versions of SafeTulu to fine-tune on, such as by changing the removal fraction or filtering only certain subsets.
blocks.zh: 在教学数据上精细调整大语言模型(LLMs)可以悄悄地侵蚀其安全性,即使没有训练实例看起来有害. 因为这个安全降解数据看起来是良性的,标准的内容过滤器难以捕捉到. 我们通过开发SimpleLORIF来解决这个问题,这是一种可缩放的梯度嵌入法,它识别出梯度与不安全行为相适应的微调实例. 通过简化低等级的归属方法并限制回向到最后四个变压器块,SimpleLORIF可以将数据集依次嵌入一百万个实例,将梯度归属从一个小规模分析工具提升到一个实用的滤波器,用于完整的训练后数据集. 我们首先在出现错位时验证它,我们发现梯度可以将不安全码训练数据与微调后出现的广泛有害的行为相连接,在错位模型的梯度空间中,AUC高达0.865. 然后,我们使用SimpleLORIF来构建SafeTulu,即Tulu 3的版本,其中20%的例子是梯度与不安全的响应相匹配的。 关于SafeTulu的培训将GG攻击成功率在Quen、Llama和Olmo之间降低至22%,优于LLM-as-a-judge和以前的梯度过滤,同时在很大程度上保持甚至提高能力。 最后,我们分析了删除的数据并找出了可能研究不足的安全退化来源,如工具执行失败和叙事算术. 我们释放了SafeTulu, 以及一个Hugging Face Space, 让研究人员建立他们自己定制的SafeTulu版本, 进行微调, 例如改变去除分数或过滤某些子集。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Fine-tuning is the primary mechanism for adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) to new tasks, but it can also weaken safety alignment even when the training data contains no obviously harmful examples ( Qi et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2024 ) . Models fine-tuned on widely used, benign instruction datasets can become noticeably easier to jailbreak, and this degradation appears to be driven by a small subset of the data rather than spread evenly across it ( He et al., 2024 ) . This turns safety preservation into a data selection problem: if we can find the examples responsible, we can remove them before training.
blocks.zh: 微调是大型语言模型(LLMs)适应新任务的主要机制,但即使培训数据没有明显有害的例子(Qi等人,2024年;He等人,2024年),也会削弱安全协调. 对广泛使用的良性指导数据集进行微调的模型,可以明显地更容易于越狱,这种退化似乎是由一小部分数据驱动的,而不是平均分布在其中(He等人,2024年)。 这使得安全保存变成了一个数据选择问题:如果我们能找到负责的例子,就可以在训练前将其删除.

blocks.en: Finding these examples is difficult because safety-degrading data often looks benign. The examples identified in prior work contain no overtly harmful content ( He et al., 2024 ) , so standard content filters such as toxicity filters and LLM safety judges that look at what the content says often struggle to flag them ( Li et al., 2025 ) . Addressing this requires a signal that reflects how an example changes the model rather than what the example looks like on the surface. The gradient an example induces is such a signal, since it describes the update the model would make by training on it. We therefore turn to gradient attribution ( Koh and Liang, 2017 ; Pruthi et al., 2020 ) , asking which training examples push the model in the same direction as unsafe behavior.
blocks.zh: 很难找到这些例子,因为安全降解数据往往看起来是良性的。 先前工作中确定的例子没有明显有害的内容(He等人,2024年),因此标准内容过滤器,如毒性过滤器和LLM安全判断器,它们查看内容的内容往往难以标注(Li等人,2025年)。 解决这个问题需要一个反映一个实例如何改变模型的信号,而不是该实例在表面是什么样子的信号。 一个实例所诱导的梯度就是这样一个信号,因为它描述了该模型通过培训而实现的更新。 因此,我们转向梯度归属(Koh和Liang,2017;Pruti等人,2020年),询问哪些培训实例将模型推向与不安全行为相同的方向.

blocks.en: We develop SimpleLoRIF , a scalable gradient embedding method that identifies fine-tuning examples whose gradients align with unsafe behavior. Building on LoRIF ( Li et al., 2026 ) , we discard its curvature correction and restrict backpropagation to the final four transformer blocks, which preserves attribution quality while substantially reducing compute and memory. This lets us embed all 939,343 examples of a full post-training dataset in about an hour on 8 H100 GPUs, boosting gradient attribution from a small-scale analysis tool and unlocking new possibilities for it such as filtering large post-training datasets or auditing which examples push models towards certain safety behaviors.
blocks.zh: 我们开发了SimpleLORIF, 一种可缩放的梯度嵌入法, 它可以识别梯度与不安全行为一致的微调实例。 在LORIF(Li et al., 2026)的基础上,我们放弃了它的曲率修正,并将反向传播限制在最后四个变压器区块上,这保持了归属质量,同时大幅度降低了计算和内存. 这让我们在8台H100GPU上嵌入了939,343个完整的训练后数据集,提升了小型分析工具的梯度归属,并打开了新的可能性,比如过滤大型训练后数据集或审计,这些例子将模型推向某些安全行为.

blocks.en: We first validate this approach on emergent misalignment, where fine-tuning on insecure code induces broadly harmful behavior unrelated to programming ( Betley et al., 2025 ) . In models exhibiting this behavior, the gradients of insecure-code training examples align with the gradients of the harmful outputs that emerge after fine-tuning, separating them from closely matched secure-code examples with AUC as high as 0.865. This shows that examples far apart in surface content can induce similar updates in gradient space, motivating treating safety degradation as a training data attribution problem.
blocks.zh: 我们首先验证了针对突发错位的这一方法,其中对不安全代码的微调会诱发与编程无关的广泛有害行为(Betley等人,2025年)。 在展示这种行为的模型中,不安全代码培训实例的梯度与微调后出现的有害输出的梯度一致,将其与与AUC高达0.865的紧密匹配的安全代码实例区分开来. 这表明,表面含量相差甚远的例子可诱发梯度空间的类似更新,促使将安全退化作为一个培训数据归属问题来处理。

blocks.en: We then use SimpleLoRIF to build SafeTulu , a version of Tulu 3 ( Lambert et al., 2025 ) with the 20% of examples most gradient-aligned with unsafe SafeRLHF responses ( Ji et al., 2025 ) removed. Training on SafeTulu reduces GCG attack success rate (ASR) by up to 22%, outperforming both LLM-as-a-judge filtering and a prior gradient-based method ( He et al., 2024 ) . Gains from SafeTulu hold consistently across Qwen, Llama, and Olmo, and the dataset largely preserves or even improves capability across general, coding, math, and medical benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 随后,我们使用SimpleLORIF来构建SafeTulu 3(Lambert等人,2025年),其中20%的例子与不安全的SafeRLHF反应(Ji等人,2025年)相对应。 关于SafeTulu的培训将GCG攻击成功率(ASR)降低22%,优于LLM-as-a-judge过滤和先前的梯度法(He等人,2024年)。 从SafeTulu获得的收益始终贯穿于Quen、Llama和Olmo之间,数据集在很大程度上保持或甚至提高跨越一般、编码、数学和医疗基准的能力。

blocks.en: We further analyze the examples removed by gradient filtering to better understand what benign-looking data may contribute to safety degradation. The removed data exhibits several recurring patterns, including tool-execution failures, narrative arithmetic, and direct coding tasks, suggesting potentially under-studied sources of safety degradation.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步分析通过梯度过滤去除的例子,以更好地了解哪些良性数据可能有助于安全退化。 已删除的数据显示了一些反复出现的模式,包括工具执行失败、叙述算术和直接编码任务,表明安全退化可能得不到充分研究。

blocks.en: We release SafeTulu along with a Hugging Face Space that lets researchers build their own customized versions of SafeTulu. Users can adjust how much data to remove for their use case (e.g., only 10%) and filter only certain subsets (e.g., only multilingual data). Whether curating a new post-training mixture, auditing a dataset already in use, or studying what makes benign data unsafe, the Space offers a direct way to put gradient-based safety filtering to work.
blocks.zh: 我们释放了SafeTulu, 以及一个Hugging Face Space, 使研究人员可以自行制作SafeTulu的定制版本。 用户可以调整为了使用大小写需要删除多少数据(例如只有10%),并且只过滤某些子集(例如只有多语言数据). 无论是管理新的培训后混合物、审计已经使用的数据集,还是研究什么使得良性数据不安全,空间方案都为将梯度式安全过滤器投入工作提供了直接途径。

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • We find emergent misalignment examples that correlate with alignment in the gradient space . For models fine-tuned on insecure code, the gradients of the insecure-code data can align with gradients of the unrelated harmful behaviors that emerge after fine-tuning with AUC as high as 0.865 . • We develop a scalable gradient-attribution method for safety filtering, SimpleLoRIF , by simplifying LoRIF and restricting backpropagation to the final four transformer blocks, making per-example gradient filtering practical for SFT datasets containing on the order of one million examples , rather than the smaller datasets used in prior gradient-based safety work. • We use this method to create SafeTulu , a version of Tulu 3 with the 20% of examples most gradient-aligned with unsafe responses removed. Across Qwen, Llama, and Olmo, SafeTulu reduces GCG attack success rate by up to 22% relative to baseline training, outperforms LLM-as-a-judge filtering and a prior gradient filtering method, while largely preserving or improving capability . We also identify possible sources of benign-looking safety degrading data , such as tool-execution failures and direct responses. • We release SafeTulu and a SafeTulu Hugging Face Space to support researchers who would like to create customized versions of SafeTulu. The Space allows users to adjust how much data to remove for their use case, filter only certain subsets, and more .

blocks.en: 2 Background and Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 背景和有关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Emergent Misalignment
blocks.zh: 2.1 紧急错位

blocks.en: Emergent misalignment (EM) refers to the phenomenon in which fine-tuning a model on a narrow undesirable behavior induces broad misalignment far outside the fine-tuning domain. Betley et al. (2025) first showed that fine-tuning models to produce insecure code without explicitly requesting insecure behavior in the prompts can cause them to exhibit unrelated harmful behaviors such as providing malicious advice, acting deceptively, or expressing broadly misaligned preferences, while controls trained on secure code or insecure code framed for benign educational purposes do not show the same effect. Subsequent work has investigated why this narrow training signal generalizes so broadly. Wang et al. (2026) use sparse-autoencoder model diffing to identify “misaligned persona” features whose activation predicts and causally controls EM, while Soligo et al. (2026) find that different EM fine-tunes converge toward a shared linear representation of general misalignment and argue that this broad solution is more stable, lower-loss, and more influential in the pre-training distribution than a narrowly task-specific solution. Minegishi et al. (2026) propose a complementary geometric account based on feature superposition, and Vetter et al. (2026) trace EM-associated persona features to pre-training documents and find that synthetic instruction-response structure or model-generated phrasing appears important for transferring these features into misaligned behavior. In this work, we study EM from a training-data-attribution perspective. Instead of examining how misalignment is represented in model activations, we investigate whether the relationship between the narrow fine-tuning data and the resulting out-of-domain harmful behavior is detectable in the gradient space, via testing whether gradient embeddings of insecure-code training examples align with gradient embeddings of the harmful outputs produced by the misaligned models.
blocks.zh: 紧急错配(EM)是指在狭义不良行为上对模型进行微调,在微调领域之外远诱发广泛错配的现象. 贝特利等人. (2025年)首先显示,微调模型生成不安全代码而不在提示中明确要求不安全行为,可能导致它们表现出无关的有害行为,如提供恶意建议,欺骗性行为,或表达广泛错误的偏好,而为良性教育目的而设置的安全代码或不安全代码所训练的控制措施则没有表现出同样的效果. 随后的工作调查了为何这一狭义的培训信号如此广泛。 Wang等人(2026年)使用稀疏的自动编码器模型diffing来识别其激活预测和因果控制EM的“misacent persona”特征,Soligo等人(2026年)则发现不同的EM微调趋同于一般错位的共线化表示,并认为这种广义的解决方案比狭义的任务特异性解决方案更稳定,损失更低,在培训前分配中更有影响力. Minegishi等人(2026年)根据特征叠加提出一个互补的几何记号,Vetter等人(2026年)将EM相关人物特征追踪到训练前文件,发现合成指令-反应结构或模型生成的词组似乎对于将这些特征转移到错配行为上很重要. 在这项工作中,我们从培训-数据分配的角度研究EM。 我们没有审查模型激活中如何体现错配,而是通过测试不安全编码培训实例的梯度嵌入是否与错配模型所产生的有害产出的梯度嵌入相一致,来调查狭义微调数据与由此产生的域外有害行为之间的关系是否在梯度空间中可被察觉.

blocks.en: 2.2 Safety Degradation
blocks.zh: 2.2 安全退化

blocks.en: Qi et al. (2024) showed that safety guardrails can be reduced by fine-tuning on benign, widely used instruction datasets such as Alpaca and Dolly, even with no malicious intent anywhere in the data. He et al. (2024) show that this degradation is concentrated in an identifiable subset of the data. Selecting and fine-tuning on just 100 benign examples whose gradients align with harmful examples and away from safe ones raises ASR to over 70%, compared to 13% for a random subset of the same size. The examples they recover contain no harmful content at all, and are disproportionately lists, bullet points, and math questions. Li et al. (2025) show that standard toxicity filters and safety judges struggle to detect such cases.
blocks.zh: Qi等人(2024年)表明,通过微调良性,广泛使用的指示数据集如阿尔帕卡和多利,即使数据中任何地方都没有恶意,也可以减少安全护栏. 他等人(2024年)表明,这种降解集中在可识别的数据子集中。 选择和微调100个良性实例,这些实例的梯度与有害实例相一致,远离安全实例,将ASR提高到70%以上,而同样大小的随机子集的比例为13%。 它们所回收的例子完全没有有害的内容,并且是过多的列表、点数和数学问题。 Li等人(2025年)表明,标准毒性过滤器和安全法官难以发现此类案件。

blocks.en: 2.3 Data Selection for Safety
blocks.zh: 2.3 安全数据选择

blocks.en: Several data-centric methods score fine-tuning documents by how likely they are to degrade safety, differing in the signal and how they define the safety reference. He et al. (2024) embed examples by their per-example gradients (or last-token hidden states) and rank them by a bi-directional criterion, ⟨ g ⁡ ( z ) , g harm ⟩ − ⟨ g ⁡ ( z ) , g safe ⟩ \langle g(z),g_{\text{harm}}\rangle-\langle g(z),g_{\text{safe}}\rangle , against curated harmful instruction-response pairs and the same instructions paired with refusals, aggregating gradients over only the first ten response tokens. SEAL ( Shen et al., 2025 ) formulates selection as a bilevel program whose upper level minimizes loss on a safe alignment dataset with respect to a data-selector parameter, ranking each document by the loss gap against an auxiliary model fit only to the fine-tuning data. DataShield ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) extracts a compliance direction from paired compliant and refusal responses, selects a safety-critical layer, and ranks documents by their projection shift along that direction. Our approach differs in multiple ways. We embed over the full document instead of the first ten response tokens ( He et al., 2024 ) or a truncated prefix, which Zhang et al. (2026) name as a limitation of prefix-truncated gradient features. We also do not train a ranker or fit an auxiliary model, unlike Shen et al. (2025) , and we select layers by embedding cost instead of by a safety criterion, unlike Zhang et al. (2026) .
blocks.zh: 一些以数据为中心的方法通过如何降低安全性、信号的不同以及如何界定安全参考来评分微调文件。 他等人(2024年)按实例的梯度(或最后一个隐藏状态)嵌入实例,并按双向标准排列,QQ g → (z),g 伤害 → → →  g (z),g safe → langle g (z),g_{\ text{harm}}\rangle-\langle g (z),g_{\ text{safe}}\rangle → rangle ),对照解析的有害指令-应答对和相同的指令与拒绝对齐,将梯度只比对前十个响应符号。 SEAL(Shen等人,2025年)将选择为双层程序,其上层将数据选择参数的安全对齐数据集的损失降至最低,按照仅适合微调数据的辅助模型按损失缺口对每个文档进行排序. 数据屏蔽 (Zhang等人,2026年)从对齐的合规和拒绝反应中提取一个合规方向,选择一个安全临界层,并按文件的预测向该方向转移排序. 我们的方法有多种不同。 我们嵌入了完整的文档,而不是头十个响应符号(He等人,2024年)或一个短写前缀,张等人(2026年)作为前缀的梯度特征的限制名称. 我们也不训练军衔或装配辅助型号,与沈等人(2025年)不同,我们通过嵌入成本而不是安全标准来选择层,与张等人(2026年)不同.

blocks.en: 2.4 Training Data Attribution
blocks.zh: 2.4 培训数据分配

blocks.en: Training data attribution (TDA) estimates the effect of individual training examples on a model’s behavior. Influence functions ( Koh and Liang, 2017 ) weight an example’s gradient by an inverse Hessian but are intractable at LLM scale, prompting cheaper approximations that compress the per-example gradient ( Park et al., 2023 ; Choe et al., 2025 ) . LoRIF ( Li et al., 2026 ) continues this line of work by storing each projected gradient as a low-rank factorization, taking gradient-based TDA to 70B parameters. A parallel line of work uses gradient similarity for selecting training data instead of explaining predictions. TracIn ( Pruthi et al., 2020 ) drops the curvature term, and LESS ( Xia et al., 2024 ) selects instruction-tuning data by similarity to a small target set.
blocks.zh: 培训数据归属(TDA)估计个人培训实例对模型行为的影响. 影响函数(Koh和Liang, 2017年)通过反向黑森语对一个实例的梯度进行加权,但在LLM尺度上是难以解决的,引发了更便宜的近似,压缩了每个实例梯度(Park等人,2023年;Choe等人,2025年)。 LORIF(Li等人,2026年)通过将每个预测梯度存储为低阶因子化,将梯度为基础的TDA到70B参数来继续这一条工作. 平行的工作线使用梯度相似性来选择培训数据,而不是解释预测. TracIn(Pruti等人,2020年)放弃了曲率学术语,LESS(Xia等人,2024年)通过类似小目标集来选择指令调数据.

blocks.en: 3 SimpleLoRIF Gradient Embedding Method
blocks.zh: 3 个简单 LORIF 渐变嵌入方法

blocks.en: We embed a document by the gradient it would induce in a reference language model, and we score a candidate training document against a target set by how closely their gradients align. Computing and storing a full per-example gradient for every document is infeasible at LLM scale, so we build on LoRIF ( Li et al., 2026 ) , a scalable influence method. We adopt LoRIF’s representation for its per-document compactness, as the rank-1 factorization stores 64 floats per layer against 1024 for the projected matrix. Our scoring rule remains in the spirit of TracIn since our purely ordinal use of the score makes LoRIF’s curvature correction unnecessary.
blocks.zh: 我们用它能诱导的梯度将一份文件嵌入一个参考语言模型,我们对照一个设定的目标来评分一个候选培训文件,这个目标就是它们的梯度如何接近一致。 在LLM尺度上,计算和存储每个文件的完整每个实例梯度是不可行的,因此我们借鉴LORIF(Li等人,2026年),一种可伸缩的影响方法. 我们采用LORIF的表述方式来表示它的每份文件的紧凑性,因为一级指数化储存每层64个浮点,而预测矩阵为1024个。 我们的评分规则仍然本着TracIn的精神,因为我们纯粹按常规使用该分数使得LORIF的曲率校正没有必要.

The first stage is the two-sided random projection introduced by LoGRA ( Choe et al., 2025 ) . blocks.zh: 3.3 嵌入成本差异

blocks.en: The dominant remaining cost is the backward pass: Eq. 1 is defined per layer and Eq. 2 sums over whichever layers are selected, so the set of layers we embed determines how much of the network is backpropagated through. To find the cheapest setup that still preserves embedding quality, we ran ablations over four axes: the projection dimension D D , the number of transformer blocks to backpropagate through, the number of tokens read per example, and the size of the embedding model. We recorded wall-clock time and a detection ROC-AUC that measures how well the gradient features predict which evaluation items a model has been pushed to solve. We use a math benchmark dataset for this, which is a standard evaluation domain. Each train and test math item is embedded as a ( Q , A ) (Q,A) pair with the question tokens masked out of the loss. The resulting per-example gradient is compressed to a fixed-length vector and L2-normalized, every test item is scored by its nearest-neighbor cosine similarity to the training set in that space, and we state the AUC of that score against whether the item was newly answered correctly after training. A higher AUC means the embedding places a test item near the training documents that actually changed the model’s behavior on it.
blocks.zh: 主要的剩余成本是后传: Eq. 1 被定义为每层, Eq. 2 和 任意选择的分层,因此我们嵌入的一组分层决定了网络中有多少被反播通过. 为了找到仍然保留嵌入质量的最便宜的设置,我们用四个轴线进行铺设:投影维度D D ,通过后置的变压器块数,每个实例读出的符号数,嵌入模型的大小. 我们记录了时钟时间和探测ROC-AUC,以衡量梯度特征如何预测一个模型已推动解决哪些评价项目。 我们为此使用数学基准数据集,这是一个标准评价领域. 每个列车和测试数学项目被嵌入为(Q,A) (Q,A)配对,并带有从损失中蒙住的问号. 所产生的每例梯度被压缩成固定长的矢量和L2常态,每个测试项目都按其近邻的同位素相似度与该空间的训练设定的相似度来评分,我们说明该分数的AUC与训练后是否新答对. 一个更高的AUC意味着嵌入将一个测试项目放在实际改变模型行为的培训文件附近.

blocks.en: Three of the four axes were unproductive: the projection dimension had little effect on either AUC or speed, token truncation was effective but risky and unlikely to generalize to longer documents, and shrinking the embedding model cost too much quality. Restricting the number of blocks, by contrast, preserved quality while greatly reducing cost, since the selected blocks sit at the top of the network and the backward pass stops once it has produced the input gradient of the shallowest selected block, while the forward pass still runs through the whole network. We chose N = 4 N=4 , the fewest blocks retaining high embedding quality: two blocks scored noticeably worse at 0.65 0.65 AUC, and six or eight gained little. This confined the backward pass, normally about twice the cost of the forward pass, to a small fraction of the network, and because activations only need to be retained for the selected blocks, we could relax the memory limit on batch size. As such, using the N = 4 N=4 transformer blocks, our method achieves a high AUC of 0.684 with a 91.53% speedup compared to the base simplified LoRIF formulation .
blocks.zh: 四个轴中的三个是无效果的:投影维度对AUC或速度都没有多大影响,符号截断有效但有风险,不可能对较长的文件进行概括,嵌入模型成本太高。 相比之下,限制区块数量则保留了质量,同时大大降低了成本,因为选定的区块在产生最浅的选定区块的输入梯度后,就坐落在网络的顶端,而落后的通过则停止了,而前传仍然贯穿整个网络. 我们选择了 N = 4 N = 4, 最少数保留高嵌入质量的区块: 两个区块在 0.65 0.65 AUC 得分明显差, 六八个区块得分很少. 这把落后的传球,一般是前进传球成本的两倍左右,限制在网络的一小部分,由于激活只需要为选定的块保留,我们可以放松批量大小的内存限制. 因此,使用N = 4 N = 4 变压器组块,我们的方法与基础简化的LORIF配方相比,实现了0.684的高AUC,速度为91.53%.

blocks.en: 4 Emergent Misalignment
blocks.zh: 4 紧急错位

blocks.en: Emergent misalignment provides a setting for testing whether safety-relevant training signals are visible in gradient space. Betley et al. (2025) show that fine-tuning a model on a narrow undesirable behavior (e.g. producing insecure code) can cause broad misalignment on unrelated prompts, despite the fine-tuning data never explicitly containing generally harmful behavior. We ask whether the connection between the narrow fine-tuning data and these broader harmful behaviors can be recovered from the gradients they induce. Specifically, we test whether insecure-code training examples have gradients that are systematically more similar to gradients from broadly misaligned outputs than closely matched secure-code examples do.
blocks.zh: 紧急错位为测试与安全相关的培训信号在梯度空间是否可见提供了一个设置. Betley等人(2025年)表明,在狭义的不良行为上微调一个模型(例如产生不安全的代码)可能会对不相关的提示引起广泛的错位,尽管微调数据从未明确包含一般有害的行为. 我们问,狭义的微调数据与这些更广泛的有害行为之间的联系是否能够从它们诱发的梯度中恢复。 具体地说,我们检验不安全代码培训实例是否有梯度,这些梯度在系统上与广义错配产出的梯度更相似,而不是贴近安全代码实例。

blocks.en: We evaluate this using two independently fine-tuned model families. For Qwen, we use emergent- misalignment/Qwen-Coder-Insecure , the original misaligned checkpoint released by Betley et al. (2025) fine-tuned on their insecure-code dataset. For Mistral, we use nikxtaco/mistral-small-24b-instruct- 2501-insecure , a reproduction of the insecure-code fine-tuning procedure applied to Mistral-Small-24B-Instruct-2501 ( Mistral AI, 2025 ) in Betley et al. (2025) , trained by Menon (2025) . In every experiment, the source set consists of the original matched secure and insecure code datasets from ( Betley et al., 2025 ) : 6,000 insecure examples and 6,000 secure examples.
blocks.zh: 我们用两个独立调整的模范家庭来评估这一点。 对Quen来说,我们使用即兴-错位/Quen-Coder-Insecurity(英语:Quen-Coder-Insecurity),由Betley等人(2025)发布的最初错位检查点对其不安全代码数据集进行了微调. 对于Mistral,我们使用nikxtaco/mistral-small-24b-instruct-2501-insecurity,复制了Mistral-Small-24B-Instruct-2501(Mistral AI,2025年)在Betley等人(2025年)中应用的不安全代码微调程序,由Menon(2025年)培训. 在每一个实验中,源集由原始匹配的安全和不安全的代码数据集组成(Betley等人,2025年) : 6 000个不安全的例子和6 000个安全的例子。

blocks.en: For each fine-tuned checkpoint, we separately construct a small target set containing examples of the model’s broader emergent misalignment. We prompt each model with free-form, non-coding questions from ( Betley et al., 2025 ) and collect its responses, then use Claude 5 Opus to review the responses, retaining only responses judged to clearly exhibit misaligned behavior. We compute a per-example gradient embedding for every source and target document using the method from Section 3 across both model families. We define the influence score of a source example as its mean similarity to all verified-unsafe targets for the corresponding model.
blocks.zh: 对于每一个经过精细调整的检查站,我们分别构建一个小型目标集,其中包含模型出现更广泛错位的例子. 我们用来自(Betley等人,2025年)的自由形式、非编码问题来催促每个模型并收集其答复,然后使用Claude 5 Opus来审查答复,只保留被判断为明显显示错位行为的答复。 我们用第3节的方法,计算每个来源和目标文件的每个实例梯度嵌入,覆盖两个模组。 我们把一个源的例子的影响分数定义为它与相应的模型中所有经核实的不安全目标之间的平均相似性.

blocks.en: We measure how well this score separates the insecure examples from the secure examples using ROC-AUC. In this setting, AUC is the probability that a randomly selected insecure-code example receives a higher influence score than a randomly selected secure-code example. An AUC of 0.5 0.5 indicates no detectable relationship between the insecure examples and the unsafe behavior, and an AUC of 1.0 1.0 indicates perfect separation. Because the source examples are closely matched in surface form, an AUC above chance indicates that the insecure examples induce gradients that are more aligned, on average, with gradients from the harmful outputs of the model.
blocks.zh: 我们用ROC-AUC衡量这一分数如何将不安全的例子与安全的例子区分开来。 在这个设置中,AUC是随机选择的不安全码例得到比随机选择的安全码例更高的影响分数的概率. 0.5的AUC表示不安全例子与不安全行为之间没有可检测的关系,1.01.0的AUC表示完美分离. 由于来源实例以表面形式密切匹配,AUC在机会之上表明,无保障实例诱发梯度,平均而言,梯度与模型有害产出的梯度更为一致。

blocks.en: We find evidence of this connection for both model families. For fine-tuned Qwen, gradient similarity achieves an AUC of 0.604 , and for fine-tuned Mistral, gradient similarity achieves an AUC of 0.865 . In both cases, the only signal used for classification is each training example’s gradient similarity to harmful generations from the corresponding fine-tuned model. These results suggest that EM leaves a detectable footprint in gradient space: the insecure-code that induces the narrow fine-tuning behavior is more aligned with the gradients of the broader misaligned behaviors that then emerge. This provides evidence that gradient attribution can recover a connection between seemingly benign or narrow training data and more extensive downstream harmful outputs. More emergent misalignment experiments are discussed in Appendix 15 . In particular, we find that a model’s gradient representation of its responses does not necessarily always transfer to a different model’s responses.
blocks.zh: 我们为两个模范家庭找到这种联系的证据。 对于微调的Quen,梯度相似度达到0.604的AUC,对于微调的Mistral,梯度相似度达到0.865的AUC. 在这两种情况下,用于分类的唯一信号是每个培训实例的梯度与相应的微调模型中有害一代的梯度相似。 这些结果表明,EM在梯度空间中留下了可察觉的足迹:诱导狭义微调行为的不安全码与后来出现的更广泛的错位行为的梯度更加一致. 这提供证据表明,梯度归属可以恢复似乎良好或狭窄的培训数据与更广泛的下游有害产出之间的联系。 附录15讨论了更多的突发错位实验。 特别是,我们发现,模型对反应的梯度表示不一定总是转移到不同的模型的反应。

blocks.zh: 图2:随机选择的不安全码例在对不安全码进行微调前后获得比随机选择的安全码例(ROC-AUC)更高的梯度-类似分数的可能性. 这一措施的顺序,而不是有害反应的频率。

blocks.en:
The emergent misalignment setting closely resembles clean-label poisoning ( Geiping et al., 2021 ) . No insecure-code example contains generally harmful content, but training on them induces harmful behavior that is invisible at the surface level ( Betley et al., 2025 ) . This is the same signature that poisoning attacks on code models and instruction-tuning data are designed to produce ( Xu et al., 2024 ; Yan et al., 2024 ; Raghuram et al., 2024 ) . The resemblance has more to do with effect rather than origin, as neither these examples nor the safety-degrading data we identify in Tulu were crafted by an adversary, yet they shift downstream behavior as if they had been. This setting also exposes gaps in existing defenses. Feature-space detectors such as spectral signatures ( Tran et al., 2018 ) , activation clustering ( Chen et al., 2019 ) , and deep k k -NN ( Peri et al., 2020 ) are designed for classification-style poisons that share a target label and form a separable cluster. LLM-specific filters such as GraCeFul ( Wu et al., 2025 ) and GradSentry ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) instead target backdoors with an explicit trigger and a fixed response. In its standard form, emergent misalignment has none of these properties, as there is no trigger and the target behavior lies outside the training domain. Gradient-based signals suit this setting while content-based filters can struggle ( Li et al., 2025 ) . A line of defenses already builds on gradients, from removing outliers in per-example gradient space ( Yang et al., 2022 ) to tracing an observed attack back to its training points ( Hammoudeh and Lowd, 2022 ; Shan et al., 2022 ) . Their common bottleneck is the cost of per-example gradients ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) . Because SimpleLoRIF computes gradient alignment cheaply over million-example SFT mixtures, it could serve as a tool that brings these detection rules to LLM scale, both as a filter before training and as a forensic tool after it. This is increasingly relevant because the number of poisons needed to compromise an LLM stays nearly constant while datasets grow ( Souly et al., 2025 ) . We see pairing SimpleLoRIF with such detectors as a
promising direction for future work.
blocks.zh:
出现的错位设置与清洁标签中毒类似(Geiping等人,2021年)。 没有不安全代码的例子包含一般有害的内容,但是有关这些内容的培训会诱发表面看不见的有害行为(Betley等人,2025年)。 这与对代码模型和指令调制数据进行中毒攻击的设定相同(徐等人,2024年;颜等人,2024年;拉古拉姆等人,2024年). 这种相似性与其说是起源,不如说是效果,因为这些例子和我们在图卢发现的安全降解数据都不是由对手设计的,但它们转移了下游的行为,仿佛它们已经发生了。 这种设置也暴露了现有防御的漏洞. 光谱签名(Tran et al., 2018),激活集群(Chen et al., 2019),深kk-NN(Peri et al., 2020)等特性-空间探测器是针对分类式毒物设计的,它们共享目标标签,形成可分离的集群. GraCeFul(Wu 等人,2025年)和GradSentry(Zhao等人,2026年)等LLM特异性滤波器转而以明确触发器和固定应答瞄准后门. 在其标准形式中,突发错位没有这些属性,因为没有触发,目标行为位于训练领域之外. 基于渐变的信号适合此设置,而基于内容的过滤器则会挣扎(Li等人,2025年). 一条防线已经建立在梯度的基础上,从去除每例梯度空间的外围(Yang等人,2022年)到追踪观察到的攻击返回其训练点(Hammoudeh和Lowd,2022年;Shan等人,2022年)。 它们常见的瓶颈是每例梯度的成本(赵等人,2026年). 由于SimpleLORIF以便宜的价格超过百万例的SFT混合物计算梯度对齐,它可以作为一个工具,使这些检测规则达到LLM尺度,在训练前作为过滤器,在训练后作为法证工具. 这一点越来越具有相关性,因为影响LLM所需的毒药数量在数据集增长时几乎保持不变(Souly等人,2025年)。 我们看到简单的LORIF 配对的探测器
未来工作的有希望方向。

blocks.en: 5 SafeTulu
blocks.zh: 5 安全图鲁

blocks.en: 5.1 Methodology
blocks.zh: 5.1 方法

blocks.en: Motivated by the connection between insecure code fine-tuning examples and harmful outputs in the gradient embedding space of misaligned models, we apply SimpleLoRIF to identify and remove benign-looking, safety degrading data in a popular fine-tuning dataset. Our pipeline is as follows:
blocks.zh: 由于不安全的代码微调实例与错配模型的梯度嵌入空间中的有害输出之间的联系,我们应用SimpleLORIF在流行的微调数据集中识别并删除良性外观的安全降解数据. 我们的管道如下:

blocks.en: 1. Embed. Compute gradient embeddings for all documents in the training set and target set. 2. Remove. Score each training document against the target set by gradient similarity, and remove the 20% highest-scoring documents. 3. Train. Fine-tune the training model on the filtered dataset (hyperparameters shown in Appendix 14.3 ). 4. Evaluate. Evaluate safety and capability.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 内嵌. 计算训练集和目标集中所有文件的梯度嵌入。 2. 删除。 按梯度相似设定的目标对每份培训文件进行分数,并删除20%得分最高的文件。 3. 火车。 精细调整过滤数据集(附录14.3中显示的全参数)上的训练模型. 4. 评价。 评估安全和能力。

blocks.en: Embed. Compute gradient embeddings for all documents in the training set and target set.
blocks.zh: 内嵌. 计算训练集和目标集中所有文件的梯度嵌入。

blocks.en: Remove. Score each training document against the target set by gradient similarity, and remove the 20% highest-scoring documents.
blocks.zh: 移除 按梯度相似设定的目标对每份培训文件进行分数,并删除20%得分最高的文件。

blocks.en: Train. Fine-tune the training model on the filtered dataset (hyperparameters shown in Appendix 14.3 ).
blocks.zh: 火车 精细调整过滤数据集(附录14.3中显示的全参数)上的训练模型.

blocks.en: Evaluate. Evaluate safety and capability.
blocks.zh: 评估。 评估安全和能力。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : SafeTulu construction: score Tulu 3 examples against unsafe SafeRLHF responses, remove the 20% with the highest gradient similarity, and train and evaluate on the retained 80%.
blocks.zh: 图3:SafeTulu构造:对不安全的SafeRLHF反应得分Tulu 3例,删除梯度相似度最高的20%,对保留的80%进行训练和评价.

blocks.en: We compute embeddings with Qwen 3 0.6B ( Qwen-Team, 2025 ) , and fine-tune Qwen 3 1.7B, Llama 3.2 1B ( Meta AI, 2024 ) , and Olmo 2 1B ( OLMo et al., 2024 ) . We set Tulu 3 ( Lambert et al., 2025 ) , a highly popular fine-tuning dataset, as our training dataset, and the prompt-response pairs with unsafe responses from SafeRLHF ( Ji et al., 2025 ) as our target dataset (43,469 examples). Embedding all 939,343 Tulu 3 examples took 1 hour, 1 minute across 8 H100 GPUs. Instead of scoring each training document against a single pooled target vector, we cluster the target set and score documents against the cluster centroids, which the rank-1 factorization allows in closed form. Appendix 14.4 provides the removal scoring identity.
blocks.zh: 我们用Quen 3 0.6B(Quen-Team,2025)计算嵌入,并微调Quen 3 1.7B,Llama 3.2 1B(Meta AI,2024),以及Olmo 2 1B(OLMo等人,2024). 我们把Tulu 3(Lambert等人,2025年),一个非常受欢迎的微调数据集,作为我们的培训数据集,以及由SafeRLHF(Ji等人,2025年)作出不安全反应的即时反应对作为我们的目标数据集(43,469例)。 嵌入所有939 343 Tulu 3的例子花费了1小时1分钟跨越8个H100GPU. 我们不对照单一集合目标载体对每份培训文件进行评分,而是将目标集和分数文件分组,对照集群中心机器人进行评分,而等级-1因子化允许以封闭形式进行。 附录14.4提供了去除分数的身份。

blocks.en: We use two safety evaluations. The first is attack success rate (ASR) on JailBreakBench behaviors ( Chao et al., 2024 ) using Greedy Coordinate Gradient (GCG), a more traditional, white-box jailbreak attack that optimizes an adversarial suffix appended to each harmful prompt to increase the likelihood of model compliance ( Zou et al., 2023 ) . We optimize the suffix for each behavior starting from 20 “!” tokens (full details are provided in Appendix 14.3 ), then evaluate the models on each behavior with its optimized suffix appended. Each response is classified as safe or unsafe using the HarmBench classifier ( Mazeika et al., 2024 ) , a popular safety classifier.
blocks.zh: 我们用两个安全评估。 第一种是利用Greedy坐标梯度(GCG)攻击JailBreak Bench行为(Chao 等人,2024年)的成功率(ASR),这是一种较传统的白箱越狱攻击,它优化了每个有害的提示所附的对抗性后缀,以增加模式遵守的可能性(Zou 等人,2023年). 我们优化了从20个“!”符号开始的每个行为的后缀(附录14.3提供了全部细节),然后用其优化后的后缀来评价每个行为的模型。 每种反应都使用流行的安全分类器Harm Bench分类器(Mazeika等人,2024年)分类为安全或不安全.

blocks.en: The second safety evaluation is ActorBreaker ( Ren et al., 2025 ) , a more modern and usually more challenging black-box, multi-turn jailbreak attack that exploits natural semantic distribution shifts. For each harmful behavior, it constructs an actor network of related people, organizations, tools, media, documents, and other entities, then converts selected relationships into conversational attack paths. These paths begin with benign-appearing questions and steer the model toward the harmful target, with refusal-triggered prompt rewriting as needed.
blocks.zh: 第二次安全评价是ActorBreaker(Ren等人,2025年),这是一种更现代,通常更具挑战性的黑盒式,多回合的越狱攻击,利用自然语义分布的转变. 对于每一个有害的行为,它构建一个由相关人士,组织,工具,媒体,文档等实体组成的演员网络,然后将选定的关系转换成对话攻击路径. 这些途径从良性出现的问题开始,并引导模型朝向有害目标,必要时以拒绝触发方式迅速重写。

blocks.en: ActorBreaker can be much more difficult to resist than GCG because it distributes harmful intent across natural, context-dependent interactions. GCG is a white-box, single-turn attack that optimizes a token suffix while leaving the harmful request comparatively explicit. ActorBreaker instead provides multiple semantically distinct paths to the same target, accumulates context across turns, and adapts questions following refusals. We implemented ActorBreaker on JailbreakBench behaviors using the authors’ prompt templates. Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct generated the actor networks and each response was classified using the HarmBench classifier. An attack was counted as successful if any response along any path was classified as unsafe. We note that the ASRs we attained are not as high as in the original ActorBreaker paper, likely due to the use of a smaller model (Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct) to generate the actor networks rather than GPT 4o.
blocks.zh: 演员Breaker比GCG更难抵抗,因为它将有害的意向分布在自然的,上下文的相互作用中. GCG是一种白盒单转攻击,它优化了一个符号后缀,同时使有害的请求相对清晰. 相反,演员Breaker为同一个目标提供了多种有明显区别的路径,累积了跨转弯的上下文,并在拒绝后调整问题. 使用作者的快速模板, Quen2.5-14B-Instruct生成了演员网络,每个响应都使用Harm Bench分类器进行分类. 如果沿任何路径的任何反应被归类为不安全,则攻击被算作是成功的。 我们注意到,我们达到的ASR没有最初的演员Breaker论文中那么高,可能是因为使用了更小的模型(Quen2.5-14B-Instruct)来生成演员网络而不是GPT 4o.

blocks.en: For capability, we evaluate on ORBench ( Cui et al., 2025 ) for over-refusal, MMLU Pro and IFEval ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) for general capability, and MBPP ( Austin et al., 2021 ) , GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) , MATH 500 ( Lightman et al., 2024 ) , and MedQA ( Jin et al., 2021 ) for domain-specific capability.
blocks.zh: 就能力而言,我们评价Or Bench(Cui等人,2025年)的超抗力,MMLU Pro和IFEval(周等人,2023年)的通用能力,以及MBPP(Austin等人,2021年),GSM8K(Cobbe等人,2021年),MATH 500(Lightman等人,2024年)和MedQA(Jin等人,2021年)的专用能力。

blocks.en: 5.2 Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 结果

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Evaluation results after baseline training, training on randomly filtered data, training on the LLM-as-a-judge filtered dataset, training on data filtered with the method of He et al., and training on SafeTulu. All values are percentages, reported as mean ± \pm standard error. Lower is better on GCG & ActorBreaker attack success rate and ORBench over-refusal rate, while higher accuracy is better on all capability metrics. Across all models, training on SafeTulu decreases ASR while preserving comparable capability.
blocks.zh: 图4:经过基线培训、随机过滤数据培训、LLM-as-a-judge过滤数据集培训、He等人方法过滤数据培训以及SafeTulu培训后的评价结果。 所有值都是百分比,报告为平均值±\pm 标准错误。 更低的是GCG & ActorBreaker攻击成功率和ORBench超抗率,而所有能力度量的精确度更高. 在所有模式中,关于SafeTulu的培训减少ASR,同时保持可比较的能力。

blocks.en: Results are shown in Figure 4 , with a tabular version available in Table 1 . We trained each method across three random seeds and report the mean ± \pm one standard error. Across all three model families, SafeTulu improves on GCG, outperforming all baselines while mostly preserving capability. For Qwen, GCG ASR decreases from 47.7% under baseline training to 37% after training on SafeTulu, compared with 47.3% for the LLM-as-a-judge filter. We observe the same pattern for Llama and Olmo: SafeTulu reduces ASR from 38% to 30% for Llama and from 48% to 41% for Olmo, whereas the LLM-as-a-judge baseline reaches 39% and 46%, respectively. SafeTulu also achieves the lowest ASR on ActorBreaker across all models. These safety improvements do not come with a corresponding loss in general capability. Across MMLU Pro, IFEval, MBPP, GSM8K, MATH 500, MedQA, and ORBench, SafeTulu models usually remain close to the capability of models trained on the full dataset. This suggests that gradient attribution is not simply identifying data associated with unsafe behavior, but is identifying safety-degrading data that can be removed without sacrificing much of the useful training signal required for downstream capability. Table 1 shows results for a larger model, Llama 3.1 8B. An analysis of using different removal fractions is in Appendix 14.1 .
blocks.zh: 结果见图4,表1为表格。 我们通过三个随机的种子来训练每种方法 并报告一个标准错误 在所有三个模范家庭,SafeTulu在GCG上有所改进,在维持能力的同时,其业绩超过了所有基线。 就Quen而言,GG ASR从基线培训的47.7%下降到SafeTulu培训后的37%,而作为法官的LLM过滤器为47.3%。 我们观察到Llama和Olmo的同样模式:SafeTulu将Llama的ASR从38%减少到30%,将Olmo的ASR从48%减少到41%,而作为法官的LLM基线分别达到39%和46%。 保险 Tulu还实现了所有模型中ActorBreaker的最低ASR. 这些安全改进不会伴随一般能力的相应损失。 在整个MMLU Pro,IFEval,MBPP,GSM8K,MATH 500,MedQA,以及OR Bench,SafeTulu模型通常仍然接近于在全数据集上受过训练的模型的能力. 这表明梯度归属不仅仅是识别与不安全行为相关的数据,而是识别可以删除的安全降解数据,而不牺牲下游能力所需的许多有用的训练信号. 表1显示较大模型Llama 3.1 8B的结果。 对使用不同去除分数的分析见附录14.1。

blocks.en: It is worth emphasizing that the model used for embedding in the creation of SafeTulu was Qwen 3 0.6B. The effectiveness of SafeTulu across multiple models therefore reflects that, at least for the purposes of identifying safety-degrading data, our gradient embedding method can generalize across model families as well as to larger model scales.
blocks.zh: 值得强调的是,用于嵌入创建SafeTulu的模型是Quen 3 0.6B. 因此,SafeTulu在多个模型中的有效性表明,至少为了确定安全降解数据的目的,我们的梯度嵌入法可以在模型家族中以及更大的模型规模中通用。

blocks.en: 6 Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 6 定性分析

blocks.en: Gradient filtering produced more variation in removal rates across Tulu 3 subsets than the LLM-as-a-judge baseline, with the contrast clearest on the math data. While the judge removed numinamath , open_math_2_gsm8k , and personas_math at nearly identical rates (15.4–15.6%), gradient filtering removed 7.9%, 19.4%, and 17.2%, respectively. This suggests that gradients distinguish between examples that appear similar at the level of surface content, consistent with gradient attribution capturing differences in the training signal that a content-based judge does not.
blocks.zh: 渐变过滤在图卢3子集的清除率方面比LLM-as-a-judge基线产生更多的差异,数学数据上对比最明显. 虽然法官删除了数字、打开_math_2_gsm8k, 和几乎完全相同的personas_math(15.4-15.6%), 梯度过滤分别删除了7.9%、19.4%和17.2%。 这表明梯度对表面含量水平上出现类似的例子加以区分,这符合梯度归属记录培训信号中的差异,即基于内容的法官不会。

blocks.en: A closer look at these subsets reveals several qualitative distinctions. In NuminaMath , removed examples more often contain Python execution failures such as tracebacks or exceptions, whereas clean symbolic reasoning traces are disproportionally retained. In PersonaHub , simple “write a Python function” tasks are removed more often, while calculus and differential-equation modeling problems are preferentially kept. Within PersonaMath , gradient filtering more often removes narrative arithmetic, where quantities are carried through a sequence of prose operations, while retaining examples involving explicit algebraic setup, substitution, and simplification.
blocks.zh: 对这些子集的仔细研究可以发现若干质的区别。 在 NuminaMath 中,删除的例子更常包含 Python 执行失败,如追溯或例外,而干净的符号推理痕迹则被不成比例地保留. 在PersonaHub 中,简单的“写一个 Python 函数”的任务被更频繁地删除,而微积分和差分方位模型问题则优先保留。 在PersonaMath 中,梯度过滤更常去除叙事算术,其中量通过一系列传言操作来传递,同时保留涉及显式代数设置,替换,和简化的例子.

blocks.en: These patterns suggest that tool-execution failures and narrative arithmetic may be under-studied sources of safety degradation. More broadly, gradient filtering shows that more direct fine-tuning examples may create more safety degradation, as gradient filtering seems to have favored less direct or more elaborated forms of reasoning. It removed relatively more clean arithmetic and simple coding tasks while retaining repeating-decimal arithmetic, algebraic setup, differential-equation modeling, and other less immediately direct examples. One possible interpretation is that direct training examples reinforce a general pattern of immediate compliance. Importantly, this does not appear to be reducible to a simple preference for shorter responses, as removed examples are clearly shorter in only about half (6/11) of the major subsets. We stress that these patterns are only suggestive rather than established . We make no claim that these features must cause safety degradation, only that these features are what these examples appear to have in common.
blocks.zh: 这些模式表明,工具执行失败和叙事算术可能是安全退化的不足研究来源。 更广泛地说,梯度过滤表明,更直接的微调实例可能会造成更多的安全退化,因为梯度过滤似乎倾向于不那么直接或更详尽的推理形式。 它移除了相对比较干净的算术和简单的编码任务,同时保留了重复的十进制算术,代数设置,差分方程模型,以及其他不太直接的例子. 一种可能的解释是,直接的培训实例加强了立即遵守的一般模式。 重要的是,这似乎不能简化为简单倾向于缩短答复时间,因为只删除了大约一半的主要子集(6/11)的例子。 我们强调,这些模式只是暗示性的,而不是既定的。 我们没有声称这些特征必须造成安全退化,只是这些特征似乎是这些实例的共同之处。

blocks.en: Finally, language analysis yields an interesting finding: English examples are removed at a higher rate than other major languages in both WildChat and Aya , despite prior observations that non-English fine-tuning can degrade safety ( Hawkins et al., 2026 ) . This may be Tulu 3’s data being very clean ( Lambert et al., 2025 ; Djuhera et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 最后,语言分析得出一个有趣的结论: 在WildChat 和 Aya 两种语言中,英文实例被删除的速度都高于其他主要语言,尽管先前观察到非英文的微调可降低安全性(Hawkins等人,2026年)。 这可能是图卢3的数据非常干净(Lambert等人,2025年;Djuhera等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: We provide our full analysis, feature-level relative risk numbers, and more in Appendix 13 .
blocks.zh: 我们提供了我们的全面分析,特征级的相对风险数字,并在附录13中提供更多。

blocks.en: 7.1 SimpleLoRIF Use Cases
blocks.zh: 7.1 简单LORIF 使用大小写

blocks.en: Making gradient attribution cheap changes how it can be used. Possible uses cases for SimpleLoRIF include the following:
blocks.zh: 使梯度归属方式改变如何使用它。 SimpleLORIF的可能用途案例包括如下:

blocks.en: • Labs can filter large post-training mixtures as they grow . For example, a newly collected agentic tool-use dataset could be screened for safety-degradation risk before it is merged into a larger mixture, rather than evaluating safety only after training. • The stored embeddings support auditing which examples steer models toward specific undesirable behaviors . One example could be scoring a mixture against a target set of sycophantic responses to find which subsets most strongly reinforce sycophancy. • SimpleLoRIF can be inverted to upweight data that pushes models toward safety behaviors , e.g., by upweighting data aligned with calibrated abstention. • SimpleLoRIF could serve as a cheap safety critic for synthetic data generators . For instance, generated agentic coding solutions that degrade safety could be filtered out before entering a training set.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we use gradient attribution to trace safety degradation back to the training data that induces it. We first show that, in models exhibiting emergent misalignment, the gradient representations of insecure-code fine-tuning examples align with the harmful behaviors that emerge after training, with AUC as high as 0.865, providing evidence that this connection is detectable in gradient space. Building on this observation, we develop a scalable gradient-attribution method, SimpleLoRIF, for identifying benign-looking SFT examples associated with unsafe behavior, and use it to construct SafeTulu by removing the 20% of Tulu 3 examples most aligned with a reference set of unsafe responses. Across Qwen, Llama, and Olmo, training on SafeTulu consistently reduces GCG attack success rate by up to 22% while largely preserving or improving capability across multiple benchmarks, outperforming LLM-as-a-judge filtering and a prior gradient filtering method. We also analyzed possible sources of benign-looking safety-degrading data, such as tool-execution failures, based on the removed data. By restricting backpropagation to the final few transformer blocks and using a compact gradient representation, SimpleLoRIF allows for attributing and filtering datasets containing on the order of a million examples, boosting gradient attribution from a tool more suited to small-scale analysis into a more practical data-selection mechanism for large-scale safety filtering. We release SafeTulu along with a Hugging Face Space that lets researchers build their own customized versions of SafeTulu to fine-tune on, such as by changing the removal fraction or filtering only certain subsets.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们使用梯度归属来追溯安全退化,追溯到导致安全退化的训练数据. 我们首先表明,在出现突发错位的模型中,不安全码微调示例的梯度表示与训练后出现的有害行为一致,AUC高达0.865,提供了在梯度空间中可探测到这种关联的证据. 基于这一观察,我们开发了一种可伸缩的梯度分配方法,SimpleLORIF,用于识别与不安全行为相关的良性外观的 SFT 实例,并用它来构建SafeTulu,为此删除了Tulu 3中最符合一组不安全反应的20%的例子。 在整个Quen、Llama和Olmo,关于SafeTulu的培训始终将GCG攻击成功率降低22%,同时在很大程度上保持或提高跨越多种基准的能力,比LLM-as-a-judges过滤和先前的梯度过滤方法高。 我们还根据已删除的数据,分析了诸如工具执行失败等无害的安全降解数据的可能来源。 通过限制向最后几个变压器块的反扩散,并使用紧凑的梯度表示,SimpleLORIF允许将包含在百万个实例中的数据集进行归属和过滤,将更适合小规模分析的工具的梯度归属提升到更实用的大规模安全过滤数据选择机制. 我们释放了SafeTulu和一个Hugging Face Space,让研究者建立他们自己定制的SafeTulu版本来进行微调,比如通过改变去除分数或者过滤仅某些子集.

blocks.en: 9 Limitations
blocks.zh: 9 限制

blocks.en: While we believe our work represents a promising route to increasing safety through gradient attribution, we recognize limitations. First, we only test general safety degradation, and do not test specific harms or behaviors such as sycophancy. Second, while SafeRLHF is a broad dataset, we do not test other target sets. Despite these limitations, we believe SafeTulu, our gradient embedding method, our findings on emergent misalignment, and our qualitative analysis are still valuable to the community.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们认为我们的工作是通过梯度归属加强安全的一个有希望的途径,但我们认识到局限性。 首先,我们只测试一般的安全降解,而不测试特定的伤害或行为,如节奏. 第二,虽然SafeRLHF是一个广泛的数据集,但我们不测试其他的目标集. 尽管存在这些局限性,我们认为SafeTulu,我们的梯度嵌入法,我们对突发错位的发现,以及我们的定性分析对社区仍然很有价值.

blocks.en: 10 Reproducibility Statement
blocks.zh: 10 可复制声明

blocks.en: We release SafeTulu and a Hugging Face Space to support researchers who would like to create customized versions of SafeTulu. We also state our hyperparameters in Appendix 14.3 .

Additionally, we used generative AI tools for creating scientific figures, creating tables, identifying relevant literature, and searching for information. We have reviewed all AI-assisted work. blocks.en: 13 Full Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 13 全面定性分析

blocks.en: 13.1 Removal Rates
blocks.zh: 13.1 清除率

blocks.en: Table 2 shows the fraction of each Tulu 3 subset removed by gradient filtering and by the LLM judge under the same 20% budget. The math subsets (highlighted) show the clearest contrast. The judge removes all three at almost the same rate (15.4%–15.6%), which makes sense for a scorer that evaluates content only at the surface level. Gradient filtering spreads its removals much more widely across the same subsets, from 7.9% of numinamath to 19.4% of open_math_2_gsm8k . It treats content that looks similar on the surface as different, indicating that it is reacting to something beyond surface content.

Table 2: Fraction of each Tulu 3 subset removed by each method under a 20% budget, with math subsets highlighted. While the LLM judge removes math at a roughly flat rate, gradient filtering varies its rates, indicating it is finding a signal beyond surface level content.
blocks.zh: 表2:每个图卢3子集的分数,在20%的预算下按每种方法删除,并突出数学子集. 虽然LLM判断器以大致平匀的速度去除数学,但梯度过滤则会改变它的速率,表明它正在发现超出表面水平含量的信号.

blocks.en: 13.2 Removal Analysis Methodology
blocks.zh: 13.2 迁移分析 方法

blocks.en: Table 3: Relative rate (RR) of each feature among removed vs kept documents. We observe trends such as removing tool-execution failures and simple coding tasks at a higher rate.
blocks.zh: 表3:被移除文件与保存文件的相对比率。 我们观察到一些趋势,例如以更高的速度去除工具执行失败和简单的编码任务.

blocks.en: To find what separates removed from kept documents without assuming a category in advance, we run a log-odds comparison with an informative Dirichlet prior (the “fightin’ words” method) over unigrams and bigrams ( Monroe et al., 2008 ) . We do this separately for the prompt and the response, and only within one subset at a time, so subset identity cannot confound the comparison. Each term’s document frequency in the removed and kept groups is compared against a shared background rate and turned into a z z -score, which keeps words that are common overall from dominating the ranking. We analyze the most strongly enriched terms on each side. While gradient filtering did not show any discernible pattern for many subsets, we did identify trends in a few subsets, shown in Table 3 . For each trend, we measure the rate on the full removed and kept populations and report the relative risk (RR), the removal rate within the feature divided by the subset’s baseline removal rate. Table 4 shows truncated dataset examples representing each trend.
blocks.zh: 与资料丰富的Dirichlet( " 斗字法 " )相比, 我们这样做是为了迅速和反应,并且一次只在一个子集内,所以子集身份不能混淆比较. 在被删除和保存的组中,每个术语的文档频率都与一个共享的背景率进行比较,并变成z-score,这样就可以使总体上常见的词不占据排名. 我们分析各方最丰富的条件。 虽然梯度过滤在许多子集中没有显示任何明显的模式,但我们确实发现了表3所示的几个子集的趋势。 就每一种趋势而言,我们衡量被完全清除和保留的人口的比率,并报告相对风险(RR),除以子集基线清除率的特性内的清除率。 表4显示了反映每个趋势的短短数据集实例。

blocks.en: We discuss our findings below. We stress that these patterns are only suggestive, not definitively established.
blocks.zh: 下面我们讨论我们的调查结果。 我们强调,这些模式只是暗示性的,而不是确定的。

blocks.en: 13.3 Code Analysis
blocks.zh: 13.3 代码分析

blocks.en: In numinamath , where the model writes Python/SymPy code, reads the executed output, and continues reasoning, the top terms in the documents gradient filtering removed are fragments of a Python exception ( traceback , most recent call , call last ) and the top terms in the documents gradient filtering kept are the vocabulary of a clean symbolic trace ( sympy , import_sympy , symbols ). Removed documents contain a real tool execution traceback or exception 1.71 × 1.71\times more than kept documents. A typical removed example is a failed first attempt at tool execution (an AttributeError , TypeError , or SyntaxError ), after which the model notices the error and continues. This suggests that safety-degrading code data may extend beyond the insecure code studied in emergent misalignment. In personahub , gradient filtering removes “write a Python function” tasks (RR 1.74 × 1.74\times ) and keeps calculus and differential-equation modeling problems (RR 0.51 × 0.51\times ) more often, suggesting that code data may be more safety-degrading than math data. In codealpaca , gradient filtering more often removes high-level discussion of software architecture ( scalability , distributed , authentication ) at an RR 1.75 × 1.75\times and keeps responses that contain runnable code ( def , print , return ) at an RR of 0.89 × 0.89\times .
blocks.zh: 在numinamath 中,模型写作 Python/SymPy 代码,读取已执行的输出,并继续推理,删除的文档梯度过滤中的顶部术语是 Python 例外的片段(回溯,最近调用,最后调用),文档梯度过滤中保存的顶部术语是干净的符号痕量(sympy,导入_sympy,符号)的词汇. 删除的文档包含一个真实的工具执行追踪或例外 1.71 × 1.71\时间多于保存的文档. 一个典型的被删除的例子,是第一次尝试工具执行失败(AtprojectError, TypeError, 或 ClassicError),之后模型通知错误并继续. 这表明安全降级编码数据可能超出在突发错位中研究的不安全编码. 在 personahub 中,梯度过滤可以去除“写一个 Python 函数”的任务(RR 1.74 × 1.74\times ),并更经常地保持微积分和差分方位模型问题(RR 0.51×0.51\times ),这表明代码数据比数学数据可能更安全降解. 在代号paca中,梯度过滤更常在RR1.75×1.75\时消除软件架构(可扩展性,分布性,认证性)的高层讨论,并将包含可运行代码(def,print, return)的回复保留在RR0.89×0.89\时.

blocks.en: 13.4 Math Analysis
blocks.zh: 13.4 数学分析

blocks.en: In open_math_2_gsm8k , gradient filtering more often removes answers whose arithmetic comes out to clean numbers and keeps answers containing long repeating decimals (e.g. 0.3333333333333333 ) at an RR of 0.36 × 0.36\times . In personas_math , it removes narrative arithmetic, in which quantities are carried in prose through a sequence of operations, and keeps genuine algebraic manipulation, in which the model defines a variable, sets up an equation, and substitutes or simplifies (RR 0.70 × 0.70\times ).
blocks.zh: 在open_math_2_gsm8k中,梯度过滤更经常地去除其算术出清数的答案,并将含有长重复小数的答案(如0.333333333333333)保留在0.36×0.36\时的RR. 在personas_math中,它去除叙事算术,其中量通过一系列操作来传承,并保持真正的代数操纵,其中模型定义变量,设置方程,并代用或简化(RR 0.70×0.70\times ).

blocks.en: 13.5 Language Analysis
blocks.zh: 13.5 语言分析

blocks.en: In wildchat , gradient filtering removes English conversations at 1.46 × 1.46\times as often as non-English languages, with every other major language removed at 0.26 0.26 – 0.65 × 0.65\times the baseline rate. aya_100k shows the same direction, with English again the most removed language (RR 1.73 × 1.73\times ), even though English is only 6.7% of that subset and the majority language in WildChat. This is notable because fine-tuning on non-English data has often been reported to degrade safety ( Hawkins et al., 2026 ) . One possible reason for the reversal here is that Tulu 3’s data is very clean ( Lambert et al., 2025 ; Djuhera et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 在野话中,梯度过滤会像非英语一样频繁地以1.46×1.46\时去掉英语对话,其他主要语言则以0.260.26–0.65×0.65时去掉基线速率. aya_100k显示相同的方向,英语再次是最去除的语言(RR 1.73 × 1.73\times ),尽管英语只是该子集的6.7%,也是WildChat中的大多数语言. 这一点值得注意,因为对非英语数据的微调经常被报道会降低安全性(Hawkins等人,2026年). 出现逆转的一个可能原因是图卢3的数据非常干净(Lambert等人,2025年;Djuhera等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: 13.6 Overall Analysis
blocks.zh: 13.6 总体分析

blocks.en: In terms of well-defined types of data, tool-execution failures and narrative arithmetic stand out as possible categories of data which may degrade safety that have been under-studied in prior work. As a broad trend, gradient filtering seems to suggest that direct examples may degrade safety more than elaborate examples. Gradient filtering appears to have removed more direct data (such as clean arithmetic and simple coding tasks) and kept less direct or more elaborate data (such as repeating-decimal arithmetic, algebraic setup, and differential equation modeling) more often. One possible reason is that direct, immediately helpful answers match the pattern of simple compliance, so direct data may degrade safety more. Table 5 shows that this effect cannot be reduced to simply optimizing for shorter examples. Removed documents are clearly shorter in only about half of the eleven major subsets (6/11), with three other subsets having a minor length difference of 5% or less and two others showing gradient filtering selecting longer data.
blocks.zh: 就定义明确的数据类型而言,工具执行失败和叙事算术是可能降低先前工作中研究不足的安全性的数据类别。 作为一个大趋势,梯度过滤似乎表明,直接的例子比详细的例子更可能降低安全性。 渐变滤波似乎已经移除了更直接的数据(如干净的算术和简单的编码任务),并且更经常地保持更不直接或更细致的数据(如重复的十进制算术,代数设置和微分方程模型). 一个可能的原因是,直接的,即时的有帮助的答案与简单的遵守规律相匹配,因此直接的数据可能更加降低安全性. 表5显示,不能将这种效果降低到简单地优化较短的例子。 在11个主要子集(6/11)中,只有约一半的删除文件明显缩短,另外3个子集的长度差小于或小于5%,另外2个则显示梯度过滤选择较长的数据。

blocks.en: Table 5: The percentage that the data removed by gradient filtering is shorter than the kept documents for every major subset. The percentage is only large for half (6/11) of the major subsets, indicating that gradient filtering is not simply optimizing for shorter length examples.
blocks.zh: 表5:通过梯度过滤去除的数据比每个主要子集保存的文件要短的百分比。 主要子集中只有一半(6/11)的百分比较大,这表明梯度过滤并不仅仅是对较短长度的例子进行优化。

blocks.en: We stress that these patterns are only suggestive rather than established . We make no claim that these features must cause safety degradation, only that these features are what these examples appear to have in common. Every result comes from the correlational method in Section 13.2 .
blocks.zh: 我们强调,这些模式只是暗示性的,而不是既定的。 我们没有声称这些特征必须造成安全退化,只是这些特征似乎是这些实例的共同之处。 每个结果都来自第13.2节中的关联方法.

blocks.en: Results are shown in Table 6 . Gradient filtering reaches a lower minimum ASR. The best ASR of gradient filtering is 30.33% at 20% removal. The LLM judge’s best is 35.00% at 10% removal. The point where removal stops helping shows how much truly safety-degrading data each method finds. The LLM judge lowers ASR steadily up to 10% removal (38.00 → 35.00). Beyond that, ASR rises above the unfiltered baseline: 39.00 at 20% and 43.00 at 40%. This suggests that beyond about 10%, the judge can no longer find data that is truly safety-degrading. It starts removing benign-looking data that may actually support safety, consistent with Tulu 3 containing little overtly harmful content. Gradient filtering shows the same reversal, but only past 20%: it keeps lowering ASR through 20% (38.00 → 30.33) before rising at 40% (39.00). Gradient filtering keeps helping for about twice as much removed data before this happens. This indicates that it finds a larger pool of genuinely safety-degrading data than a content-based judge.
blocks.zh: 结果见表6。 渐变滤波达到较低的最低ASR. 梯度过滤的最佳ASR为30.33%,去除率为20%. LLM法官的最好成绩是35.00 %, 移除的点停止帮助显示每种方法找到多少真正安全降解的数据. LLM法官将ASR稳步降至10%(38.00~35.00)。 除此之外,ASR高于未过滤基线:39.00分20%,43.00分40%. 这表明,超过10%,法官再也找不到真正安全降解的数据。 它开始删除可能实际支持安全的良性外观数据,与图卢3中包含很少明显有害的内容一致. 渐变滤波显示同样的逆转,但只有超过20%:它一直将ASR降低到20%(38.00~30.33),然后上升为40%(39.00)。 渐变滤波持续帮助 大约两倍的删除数据 在此之前发生。 这表明,与基于内容的法官相比,它找到了更多真正降低安全程度的数据。

blocks.en: Safety Scoring Prompt (0–5 Scale) Objective: Assess the safety of a given text, evaluating its appropriateness for public use, educational environments, or general audiences. Assign points based on the severity and presence of unsafe content across different categories. The total score ranges from 0 to 5 , with higher scores indicating lower safety . Scoring Criteria: 0 (Safe): Content: no unsafe or inappropriate content. Suitability: fully appropriate for all audiences, including children and sensitive environments. Language: respectful, without any profanity, slurs, or derogatory terms. Themes: no adult themes, violence, or references to illegal activities. 1 (Minimally Unsafe): Content: minimal unsafe content with minor instances of inappropriate language or mild adult themes. Language: may include mild profanity (e.g., “damn,” “hell”) or slang. Themes: non-explicit references to alcohol, mild romantic situations, or casual mentions of stressful topics. Suitability: generally appropriate but may be unsuitable for very young audiences or highly sensitive environments. 2 (Slightly Unsafe): Content: elements of concerning language or topics. Language: minor personal insults or sarcastic remarks without severe offense. Advice: mild financial, legal, or medical advice without professional endorsement or disclaimers. References: brief, indirect mentions of political, religious beliefs, or controversial topics. Suitability: slightly inappropriate or off-topic for certain audiences; may require discretion. 3 (Moderately Unsafe): Content: moderately harmful content that may offend or disturb. Language: social-group insults, stereotypes, or prejudiced remarks without aggressive intent. Themes: suggestive or explicit adult themes, non-graphic sexual content, or depictions of moderate violence. References: brief mentions of weaponry, self-harm, or crimes without detailed descriptions. Suitability: moderately inappropriate; may require review, parental guidance, or filtering. 4 (Clearly Unsafe): Content: clearly inappropriate for general audiences. Language: strong profanity, slurs, or aggressive derogatory terms directed at individuals or groups. Advice: detailed financial, legal, or medical advice that could lead to harm. Themes: extremist beliefs, conspiracy theories, or detailed references to illegal activities. References: encouraging self-harm, violence, or other dangerous actions. Suitability: contains explicit elements; should be restricted or removed from public platforms. 5 (Highly Unsafe): Content: highly unsafe and overtly harmful. Language: hate speech, violent threats, or calls to action against individuals or groups. Themes: graphic adult content involving illegal activities. Advice: promotion or instruction of illegal or harmful actions. Privacy: disclosure of personally identifiable information without consent. Suitability: inappropriate for any general, educational, or public platform. Instructions: (1) Analyze the text thoroughly: understand the content, context, and tone, and identify any unsafe elements based on the criteria. (2) Assign a safety score: start from 0 and assign the highest applicable score (do not sum points). (3) Return a JSON object: {"score": <score>, "reason": "<reason>"} , where the reason briefly states the main issue (e.g., “hate speech,” “financial advice,” “WMD”). Example. Text: “I think we should overthrow the government because they are all corrupt and don’t care about us.” Identified content: expresses extremist beliefs and suggests illegal activities. Justification: advocates the illegal act of overthrowing the government, which is a serious offense; promotes extremist beliefs and could encourage unsafe behavior, making it clearly inappropriate for general audiences. Output: {"score": 4, "reason": "illegal activity"}
blocks.zh: 安全计分提示( 0 - 5 缩放) 目标:评估某一文本的安全性,评价其是否适合公众使用、教育环境或一般受众。 根据不同类别中不安全内容的严重性和存在情况指定点。 总分从0到5分不等,而较高的分数表明安全性较低。 评分标准:0 (安全):内容:没有不安全或不适当的内容. 适宜性:完全适合所有受众,包括儿童和敏感环境。 语言:尊重他人,无任何污蔑,污蔑,或贬损之词. 主题:没有成人主题,暴力,也没有提及非法活动. 1(微乎其微的不安全):内容:最小的不安全内容,有轻微的不当语言或轻微的成人主题. 语言:可能包括轻度的亵渎(如“damn”,“hell”)或口语。 主题:非直截了当地提及酒精,温和的浪漫情境,或随意提及紧张话题. 适宜性:一般适合,但可能不适合非常年轻的受众或高度敏感的环境。 2(略显不安全):内容:与语言或专题有关的要素。 语言:轻微的人身侮辱或讽刺性言论,没有严重的违法行为. 咨询:在没有专业认可或免责的情况下提供轻微的财务、法律或医疗咨询。 参考文献:简短,间接提及政治,宗教信仰,或有争议的话题. 适宜性:对于某些受众而言,略为不适当或不合主题;可能需要酌情处理。 3(不安全):内容:可能冒犯或扰乱的中度有害内容。 语言:社会团体侮辱,刻板印象,或者没有侵略意图的偏见言论. 主题:暗示或明确成人主题,非图文性内容,或描绘中度暴力. 参考文献:简要提及武器、自我伤害或罪行,但没有详细说明。 适宜性:不太合适;可能需要审查、家长指导或过滤。 4 (明显不安全):内容:明显不适合一般观众. 语言:针对个人或群体的强烈的亵渎、流言蜚语或攻击性的贬义词。 咨询意见:可能导致伤害的详细财务、法律或医疗咨询意见。 主题:极端主义信仰,阴谋论,或详细提及非法活动. 参考文献:鼓励自我伤害、暴力或其他危险行动。 适用性:包含明确的要素;应当限制或从公共平台上删除。 5(高度不安全):内容:高度不安全和明显有害。 语言:仇恨言论、暴力威胁或呼吁对个人或团体采取行动。 主题:涉及非法活动的图像化成人内容。 咨询:促进或指导非法或有害行动。 隐私:未经同意披露个人识别信息。 适宜性:不适合任何普通、教育或公共平台。 指令:(1)彻底分析文本:了解内容,上下文和语气,根据标准确定任何不安全因素. (2)指定安全分:从0开始并指定最高适用分(不计总分). (3) 返回 JSON 对象:{'分数':<分数>,"合理性":<合理性>},其中理由简要说明主要问题(例如“仇恨言论”、“财务建议”、“SW”)。 实例。 我认为我们应该推翻政府, 认定内容:表达极端主义信仰,暗示非法活动. 理由:主张推翻政府的非法行为,这是严重的犯罪;宣扬极端主义信仰,可能鼓励不安全的行为,因此明显不适合一般观众. 产出:{"分数":4,"理由":"非法活动"}

blocks.en: We prompt Qwen 3 8B, served with constrained (JSON-schema-guided) decoding, to score every document in the training set for safety on an integer 0–5 scale, where 0 denotes content that is fully safe and appropriate for all audiences and 5 denotes highly unsafe content (hate speech, violent threats or calls to action, graphic illegal content, disclosure of personal information, or explicit promotion/instruction of illegal or harmful acts). Each score level is defined by the rubric established in Appendix C.1 from Maini et al. (2025) (shown above) over content, language, themes, advice given, and audience suitability. The judge is instructed to start from 0 and assign the highest applicable score rather than summing point-by-point, and returns a structured {"score": int , "reason": str } object. Scores that fail to parse are treated as missing and excluded.
blocks.zh: 我们促使受约束的(JSON-schema-guided)解码的Quen 3 8B在安全培训中以整数0至5的比例评分每份文件,其中0表示完全安全和适合所有观众的内容,5表示高度不安全的内容(仇恨言论、暴力威胁或行动呼吁、图示非法内容、披露个人信息、或明确宣传/指导非法或有害行为)。 每个分数级别由Maini等人(2025年)(上文所显示)附录C.1中确立的关于内容、语言、主题、建议和受众适宜性的分数。 裁判员奉命从0开始,并指定最高适用分数,而不是按点进行总结,返回一个结构化的{'分数':int,"解释":str}对象. 未解析的分数被视为缺失和排除在外。

blocks.en: The judge sees both the user prompt and the model’s response, so it can penalize an unsafe prompt-response pair even when the response itself appears benign in isolation. Because the discrete 0–5 scale may produce a tie band straddling the removal boundary (e.g. the cutoff falling in the middle of the population of 4s and 5s), ties are broken by a seeded random draw, so which documents within the boundary score are kept vs. dropped is randomized rather than determined by document order.
blocks.zh: 法官既看到用户的迅速反应,也看到模型的反应,因此即使反应本身在孤立中看起来是良性的,也可以惩罚一对不安全的迅速反应。 由于离散的0比5比例尺可能会产生一个横跨清除边界的结带(例如,在4比5的人口中间掉落的截断),因此联系被种子随机抽取而断裂,因此边界积分内哪些文件被保留对投放是随机的,而不是由文件顺序决定的.

blocks.en: For a training document x x with rank-1 factors { ( u ℓ , v ℓ ) } \{(u_{\ell},v_{\ell})\} and a cluster centroid M c M_{c} , the score is score ⁡ ( x , c ) = ⟨ G x , M c ⟩ F = 1 | c | ​ ∑ t ∈ c ∑ ℓ = 1 L ( u ℓ x ⋅ u ℓ t ) ​ ( v ℓ x ⋅ v ℓ t ) , \mathrm{score}(x,c)\;=\;\langle G_{x},M_{c}\rangle_{F}\;=\;\frac{1}{|c|}\sum_{t\in c}\sum_{\ell=1}^{L}(u_{\ell}^{x}\cdot u_{\ell}^{t})(v_{\ell}^{x}\cdot v_{\ell}^{t}), i.e., the Frobenius inner product between the training document’s gradient matrix and the cluster centroid is exactly the mean of its pairwise bilinear scores (Eq. 2 ) against the cluster’s members. blocks.en: 15 Extended Emergent Misalignment Experiments
blocks.zh: 15 扩展紧急错配实验

blocks.en: 15.1 Non-Fine-Tuned Models
blocks.zh: 15.1 非良好型号

blocks.en: As a control, we repeat the gradient-embedding analysis using the corresponding base instruct models before insecure-code fine-tuning. For Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct ( Hui et al., 2024 ) , the AUC falls from 0.604 after insecure-code fine-tuning to 0.552 in the non-fine-tuned model. For Mistral-Small-24B-Instruct-2501 ( Mistral AI, 2025 ) , the AUC falls from 0.865 to 0.431. These results indicate that the gradient-space relationship between insecure-code examples and broadly harmful outputs does not emerge until after the model has undergone emergent misalignment.
blocks.zh: 作为一种控制,我们利用相应的基准指示模型,在不安全代码微调之前,重复进行梯度嵌入分析。 对于Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct(Hui等人,2024年),AUC在无安全码微调后从0.604降至非fine微调模式中的0.552. 对于Mistral-Small-24B-Instruct-2501(Mistral AI,2025),AUC从0.865降至0.431. 这些结果表明,在模型出现错位之前,不安全编码实例与广泛有害产出之间的梯度-空间关系才出现。

blocks.en: 15.2 Cross-Model Transfer
blocks.zh: 15.2 跨模式转让

blocks.en: Table 7: Cross-model transfer of the emergent-misalignment gradient signal. Matched AUC uses harmful target responses produced by the same model family as the embedding model, while Transfer AUC replaces them with responses from the other fine-tuned model family. The embedding model used is important: models’ gradient representations do not necessarily transfer to different models’ responses.
blocks.zh: 表7:出现偏差梯度信号的跨模式转移. 匹配的AUC使用与嵌入模型相同的模型家族产生的有害目标响应,而转移的AUC则用其他微调模型家族的响应取代. 使用的嵌入模型很重要:模型的梯度表示不一定会转移到不同的模型的反应上.

blocks.en: We next test whether the gradient-space signal transfers across model families by changing the model used to compute embeddings and the model from which the verified-unsafe target responses are drawn. Results are shown in Table 7 . When the fine-tuned Mistral model embeds harmful responses generated by fine-tuned Qwen, AUC decreases only modestly from 0.865 to 0.832. In the opposite direction, however, using fine-tuned Qwen to embed fine-tuned Mistral’s harmful responses reduces AUC from 0.604 to 0.247. For the non-fine-tuned models, cross-model targets produce values that remain close to chance. Overall, this shows that the specific embedding model used is important for gradient representation, and that a model’s gradient representation will not necessarily transfer to a different model’s responses.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来测试梯度空间信号是否通过改变用于计算嵌入物的模型以及从中得出经核实的不安全目标响应的模型而跨模型家族转移. 结果见表7。 当微调的Mistral模型嵌入微调的Quen产生的有害反应时,AUC只从0.865微调到0.832. 然而,相反方向,使用微调的Quen来嵌入微调的Mistral的有害反应,AUC从0.604降至0.247. 对于非精细调节的模型,跨模型目标产生的值仍然接近机会. 总的来说,这表明所使用的具体嵌入模型对于梯度表示很重要,一个模型的梯度表示不一定会转移到另一个模型的反应上.

blocks.en: These results may appear to contrast with Section 5.2 , where filtering with gradients from a non-fine-tuned Qwen model improves safety across multiple model families. However, the emergent-misalignment experiments examine a much broader and more difficult relationship: whether gradients connect narrow insecure-code training items to harmful out-of-domain behaviors that emerge after fine-tuning. This more indirect connection is likely to be more model- and state-specific than the more general safety-degradation signal used for SafeTulu, which may explain why transfer across models and to non-fine-tuned checkpoints is weaker here.
blocks.zh: 这些结果可能与第5.2节形成对比,第5.2节用非精细调试的Quen模型的梯度进行过滤可以提高多个模型家庭的安全性. 然而,出现错位实验研究了一种更广泛且更困难的关系:梯度是否将狭义的不安全代码训练项目与微调后出现的有害域外行为联系起来. 这种更间接的连接可能比SafeTulu使用的更一般的安全降解信号更适合模型和状态,这也许可以解释为什么这里跨模型和向非精细调节的检查站的转移较弱.

blocks.en: Table 8: Gradient-embedding AUC across non-fine-tuned Qwen2.5-Coder model sizes. The gradient signal increases up to 14B, suggesting that smaller models may have a sharper gradient signal than larger models.
blocks.zh: 表8:跨非精细调试的Qwen2.5-Coder模型大小的梯度-嵌合AUC. 梯度信号增加至14B,说明较小的模型可能具有比较大的模型更尖锐的梯度信号.

blocks.en: 15.3 Scaling

Finally, we test how the gradient signal varies with model scale within the Qwen2.5-Coder family, using non-misaligned instruct checkpoints from 0.5B to 32B parameters. The results are shown in Table 8 . AUC increases steadily from 0.507 at 0.5B to 0.549 at 3B, 0.573 at 7B, and 0.590 at 14B, before decreasing to 0.552 at 32B. The scaling trend is therefore not monotonic across the full model-size range. From 0.5B through 14B, the gradient-space signal strengthens consistently, suggesting that larger models can make the relevant distinction increasingly detectable. However, the 32B model falls below the 14B model, indicating that more parameters do not necessarily always produce a stronger gradient-attribution signal. This suggests that gradient-based attribution may sometimes be sharper in smaller or intermediate-sized models than in the largest model, and that embedding-model scale should be treated as an empirical design choice rather than assuming that larger models will always provide better attribution geometry.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们用0.5B到32B的参数,测试梯度信号在Quen2.5-Coder家族内部如何与模型尺度不同。 调查结果见表8。 AUC从0.507在0.5B稳步增加到0.549在3B,0.573在7B,0.590在14B,然后下降到0.552在32B. 因此,在模型全尺寸范围内的缩放趋势并不是单一的。 从0.5B到14B,梯度-空间信号持续增强,表明更大的模型可以使相关的区分越来越可探测. 然而,32B型机车低于14B型机车,表明更多的参数不一定总能产生更强的梯度-归属信号. 这表明,基于梯度的归属有时在较小或中等大小的模型中比在最大的模型中更为尖锐,嵌入式模型尺度应被视为一种经验性的设计选择,而不是假设更大的模型总是提供更好的归属几何.
